title: My Bubble Sort Lesson
source_text:
Bubble sort sorts a list into ascending order.

Compare adjacent elements from left to right. Swap them if the
left value is greater than the right value.

After one complete pass, the largest remaining value reaches
the right end. The rest of the list may still be unsorted,
so repeat passes.

Stop after a complete pass with no swaps, or after n-1 passes.

Example: [3,2,1] becomes [2,1,3] after the first pass,
then [1,2,3] after the second pass.

Marking criteria: adjacent comparisons, conditional swaps,
repeated passes and stopping conditions. Give each equal weight.
